cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(AnAnArchiverBzip2 LANGUAGES C)
if(NOT DEFINED ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE is required")
endif()
set(bzip2_sources blocksort.c huffman.c crctable.c randtable.c compress.c decompress.c bzlib.c)
list(TRANSFORM bzip2_sources PREPEND "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}/")
add_library(bz2 STATIC ${bzip2_sources})
target_include_directories(bz2 PUBLIC "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}")
set_target_properties(bz2 PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(bz2 PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
install(TARGETS bz2 ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}/bzlib.h" DESTINATION include)
